verdict.rationale: Lago publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 schema and API reference with a generated command per endpoint, explicitly positioned for generating clients or exposing actions to AI agents, and this is corroborated by a live openapi.json probe plus an llms.txt/docs.md AI-friendly surface. It also ships an 'Agent SDK' for wrapping LLM clients into billing workflows, showing first-party SDK tooling beyond just API docs.  Missing for 10: explicit list/repos of named official SDKs per language (Python, Node, Ruby, etc.) and independent hands-on developer confirmation of SDK quality.
